    About Us

    HouseMatch is on a mission to help you find your dream rental home. We specialize in connecting individuals with their perfect living spaces through a seamless online platform. Our focus is to simplify the rental search process and ensure that you discover the ideal home that suits your needs and preferences.

    Our Team.

    Sylmira Kailey

    Sylmira Kailey is a senior from Downingtown, PA, pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a Minor in Marketing. Her main interests are in human-computer interaction and technology policy. For her capstone project, she developed the application logic and interaction between the database and frontend systems, including data management and API integrations. Following graduation, she will be working in the Technology Leadership Program at the Vanguard Group.
